Route pre-check: requested claude-sonnet-5-5 / xhigh, no A/G/S class named in field 6; observed model identity claude-sonnet-5-5 (this dispatch's runtime prompt); no contradiction. independent review: pending. Outcome: PARTIAL (DoD item 1 not met: one further native red, see 6). Not a closing-allowance handover; the 80 % notice arrived at hook call 44 and everything after it was verification, commit and record.

1. DoD results.
(a) Native after: PARTIAL. 59 tests, 49 pass, 2 fail, 8 skipped (before: 57 tests, 48 pass, 9 fail). Fails: the new pin (expected, GES-EXISTING-REPOSITORY-BINDING at the observer assert, so the hardening precondition passed) and a FURTHER red, case :1100 restricted storage (GES-RESTRICTED-WINDOWS-ASSURANCE, DACL assurance 'unavailable', raised by putRestrictedGovernanceEvent via assertRestrictedRoot create:true at store.mjs:1716). Typed skips: SYMLINK-EPERM x5 (:530 forked-stream case, fork-disposition ancestor, intent-fields, NVA-REPOID-1 alias, the new symlink-alias half of the :1320 split; the :530 one is inferred from the total of 8, its line sits above the region I read); POSIX-MODE-UNHONOURED x3 (:1247, and the :1307 and :1332 cases with the existing-binding product-fault suffix).
(b) WSL before and after: PASSED. before 57/57 pass exit 0; after 59 tests, 58 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped. The one skip is the new pin (POSIX-MODE-HONOURED), skipped by design. No pre-existing case changed state; the +2 tests are the :1320 split and the pin.
(c) check-consumer-safe-paths: PASSED 9/9 exit 0.
(d) Commit: PASSED 17403f215, exact subject, trailers Dispatch + AI-Assisted only, one file.

2. Evidence (repo-relative, capture-evidence.mjs, exit codes): evidence/WIN-GES-T3-20261009/wsl-before.txt (0), native-before.txt (1), native.txt (1), wsl-after.txt (0); node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs exit 0.

3. Changed files: plugins/pipeline-core/lib/governance-event-store.test.mjs (+86/-14): symlinkOrSkip and hostHonoursPosixModeBits helpers; five symlink sites on the probe; :1247 probe skip; :1100 fixture root created through assertRestrictedRoot(create:true) and its POSIX mode assertion guarded by the probe; :1320 split in two; :1307 and :1332 probe-skipped; the RED pin added.

4. Deliberately not changed: all production files; the refusal cases :1298, :1302, :1312, :1328 (no assertion change); the pre-existing foreign staged and dirty files; the evidence artifacts and this record stay untracked.

5. Deviations. (i) :1307 and :1332 are probe-skipped, not left red: the brief names them with the pin but its DoD allows only the pin as a native red, and a skip is the only test-only way; un-skip them when WIN-GES-F4 lands. (ii) The :1100 mode assertion (stat mode & 0o077) is now guarded by the probe: a win32 directory reports 0o777, so it could never hold. It is unreached on win32 because the case stops earlier. (iii) The pin first hardens the binding directory with the production hardener (dynamic import of windows-private-state.mjs, status asserted secure), so F4's DACL assessor can turn it green without a rewrite. (iv) :530 had its symlink block moved last so an EPERM skip drops nothing else; the skipped :530 case still ran its non-symlink assertions first. (v) :1320 titles changed, and a wrong claim in the commit body: it says the chmod 0o600 restore before the file-symlink step was dropped, but it was KEPT (redundant, harmless) in the symlink-alias half; the commit is not amended. (vi) :1247 is skipped whole on this host class. (vii) Hook-counted tool uses ran about 2 below my own tally.

Refusal-case vacuity on win32 (source reading plus the identical code seen for a VALID binding in native-before.txt :1307 and in the pin; per-case win32 paths not separately instrumented): :1298 is NOT vacuous (refuses at lstat ENOENT before the mode predicate; its no-namespace assertion is its own). :1302, :1312 (all 8 mutations) and :1328 (size and mode both fire) refuse for the mode predicate and cannot discriminate. Tightening: ZERO changes, because the module has one code and one message for every predicate (store.mjs:891, catch-all :930). Untested idea for F4 or a follow-up: a win32 read-only-attribute file reports 0o444, which passes the predicate and would let those cases reach their own reasons.

6. Open items. (A) :1100 still red natively: the fixture fix works (the first plan step now passes) and the failure moved to put's own create:true re-harden of an already-hardened root returning 'unavailable'. Cause undiagnosed and unprobed; hypothesis: harden is not idempotent on win32, which would make every second put on a real win32 machine fail. Product side, left alone; the hunk is committed because it is correct and green on WSL, revert it if you prefer the case untouched. (B) The pin is RED by design until WIN-GES-F4. (C) Independent Critic review pending; PO acceptance pending.
Structured handover. Committed: 17403f215 (test file only, all of the above). Verified green: WSL 59/58+1 skip exit 0; consumer-safe-paths 9/9. Remains undone: :1100 green on win32; pin green; untracked evidence dir and this record. Next briefing: probe harden idempotency on win32 first (two consecutive hardenWindowsPrivateDirectory calls on one directory), then decide whether :1100 is a product slice or a fixture slice.
